title: RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 Is MASSIVE - What Actually Matters
author: Kodeations
chapters: New Gear (Rune, Black Dragonhide, Ancestral, Wands)
Combat Overhaul (Parry, Visceral Attacks, Spec Bar, Animation Cancel)
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is finally live. Early Access is over, crossplay is on, and the Scorned Wilderness raid against Kuldra is the new endgame.

This video cuts through the fluff and covers what actually matters in the full launch: the raid, rune / black dragonhide / ancestral / dragon gear, wands, combat changes, Home Teleport, the Storage Ledger, and the biggest quality-of-life updates.

0:00 1.0 Is Live
0:14 Full Launch + Crossplay
0:46 Scorned Wilderness Raid + Kuldra
1:25 New Enemies
1:38 New Gear (Rune, Black Dragonhide, Ancestral, Wands)
2:47 Dragon Armor + Kuldra Rewards
3:25 New Resources + Advanced Spinning Wheel
3:52 Skill Changes (Home Teleport, Storage Ledger)
5:40 Combat Overhaul (Parry, Visceral Attacks, Spec Bar, Animation Cancel)
7:39 2,665 Bug Fixes
8:33 Roadmap Tease + Luminance

Dragonwilds 1.0 platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, Epic Games Store, Jagex Launcher. Crossplay is live.

What are you most excited about in 1.0? Drop it in the comments.

Official Dragonwilds Discord: https://discord.gg/rsdragonwilds 
Patch notes: https://dragonwilds.runescape.com/news/launch
